name: aaronyang-agent-plugins
description: Aaron Yang's agent plugins for Claude Code and GitHub Copilot

plugins.name: writing-rules
plugins.description: Write lean agent instructions that change behavior, place each rule where it belongs, and verify rules with evals

plugins.name: plain-explain
plugins.description: Explain ideas to non-specialists: term, plain explanation, everyday analogy, numbered references

plugins.name: knowledge-notes
plugins.description: Ingest knowledge into your own knowledge base by following its existing structure

plugins.name: gmail-tools
plugins.description: Gmail as code: archive statement and receipt PDFs by month, manage filters from a TOML file with lint and backfill, and triage the inbox

plugins.name: file-archiving
plugins.description: File personal documents safely: PARA structure, hash-verified moves, append-only evidence, yearly folders, manifests as the source of truth

plugins.name: reflection
plugins.description: Capture lessons into a reflection queue as they happen and review them in batches, moving each to the place where it changes behavior
